# Worker Service Recovery Checkpoint Commit Rule

In the Worker Service recovery path, the queue checkpoint must be committed only after both the artifact manifest rename and artifact blob rename operations succeed. If either rename fails, the checkpoint remains at its prior offset to allow job retry.

# Quarantine Test Policy

Intermittent test failures trigger the @quarantine tag, moving tests from the blocking ci-integration job to the non-blocking nightly-quarantine job. Quarantined tests do not gate merges, requiring the owning team to fix or delete them within five working days.

# DNS TTL Adjustment Procedure

Lower DNS record TTL to 60 seconds one day before pointing to a new target, then restore to 3600 seconds after the new target serves traffic for 24 hours. All record changes must be made in `dns/zones.tf` and never through the provider console.
